title: Social media fast: Friday evening through Saturday bedtime
discussion_signal: Bryan Johnson invites followers to join a 36-hour social-media fast; indexed replies include support, jokes, and a suggestion that a national internet shutdown would be needed.
linked_research_question: Whether short, public, collective breaks reduce attention pressure or become another performative platform ritual.
engagement: A mirror exposed replies and one visible reply count but not a stable platform-wide reach measure.
limits: Direct X page may require login and was not fully inspectable
Reply sample comes from an indexed mirror, not a reproducible X API export
Health claims are not treated as established causal results
